title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Regional Sales Executive
description:
We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Regional Sales Executive to drive the regional sales and affiliate partnership efforts in Brazil. Reporting to the Country Manager, you will be responsible for acquiring and managing new affiliate partners, driving the region's growth, and developing strategic relationships to elevate the company’s market position. This full-time role will provide an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the company's expansion while focusing on affiliate partnerships to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Affiliate Partner Acquisition & Management : Identify, onboard, and manage new affiliate partners, merchants, and strategic partners to expand the company’s affiliate network and drive revenue growth in Brazil.
  • Partnership Development & Negotiation: Negotiate affiliate terms, contracts, and collaboration agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes. Work closely with the marketing team to create tailored campaigns and offers that align with affiliate partners’ audiences and Bybit’s brand.
  • Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with affiliates, monitoring the performance of partnerships, and providing ongoing support and resources to optimize results. Foster long-term relationships with affiliates, ensuring they have the tools, incentives, and resources to succeed. Act as the main point of contact for affiliates, addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Affiliate Onboarding : Guide new affiliates through the onboarding process, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and understanding of the company’s offerings to drive performance.
  • Market Insights & Strategy : Conduct in-depth market research to identify emerging trends, competitive strategies, and new affiliate opportunities. Use these insights to refine outreach and acquisition strategies.
  • Sales & Affiliate Reporting : Track and analyze key performance metrics related to affiliate performance, client acquisition, and outreach efforts. Report progress to the Country Manager and provide strategic feedback to improve future efforts.
  • Administrative & Organizational Support : Oversee administrative tasks related to affiliate management, including record-keeping, scheduling meetings, managing communication, and preparing performance reports.
  • Event Coordination : Assist in the planning and execution of events focused on building affiliate partnerships, such as affiliate conferences, merchant meetups, or industry workshops.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in sales, affiliate marketing, or business development with a focus on managing relationships and partnerships.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively pitch affiliate opportunities and build rapport with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic mindset with a keen understanding of affiliate marketing trends, market dynamics, and how to leverage them for business success.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of handling multiple projects, managing time effectively, and keeping affiliate partners engaged and satisfied.
  • Self-starter with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a passion for driving business results through affiliate partnerships.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Gestão e Expansão de Carteira

  • Gerir com autonomia e profundidade uma carteira de contas estratégicas, desenvolvendo planos de conta individualizados com metas claras de retenção, crescimento e aprofundamento de relacionamento.
  • Identificar e estruturar oportunidades de up-sell e cross-sell de forma proativa, com base em análise de maturidade do cliente, consumo atual e potencial de expansão.
  • Monitorar indicadores de saúde das contas (health score, NPS, churn risk, expansão de receita), traduzindo dados em ações táticas e planos de mitigação.
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas de negócio (QBRs e EBRs) com stakeholders estratégicos dos clientes, apresentando resultados, roadmaps de valor e iniciativas conjuntas de crescimento.


Relacionamento e Influência Estratégica

  • Construir e aprofundar relacionamentos em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos dentro dos clientes — operacional, gerencial e executivo — criando vínculos de longo prazo baseados em confiança e entrega de valor consistente.
  • Posicionar-se como consultor de confiança do cliente, antecipando necessidades, propondo iniciativas antes que sejam demandadas e participando ativamente de discussões sobre estratégia e resultados do negócio do cliente.
  • Mapear e gerenciar o ecossistema de influenciadores e decisores de cada conta, desenvolvendo estratégias de engajamento customizadas por persona.
  • Atuar como defensor interno do cliente, garantindo que as demandas e expectativas das contas estratégicas sejam priorizadas adequadamente pelas áreas de produto, operações e suporte.


Retenção e Crescimento de Receita

  • Ser o principal responsável pelo atingimento das metas de Net Revenue Retention (NRR) e Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) da carteira sob gestão.
  • Desenvolver estratégias de renovação antecipada e condução de processos de renegociação complexos, equilibrando flexibilidade comercial com preservação de margem e percepção de valor.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais estratégicas e materiais de apresentação executiva, com narrativa clara orientada ao ROI e ao impacto de negócio do cliente.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que a entrega sustente a percepção de valor e reduza o risco de churn.


Inteligência de Mercado e Contribuição Estratégica

  • Monitorar movimentos competitivos, tendências de mercado e mudanças no ambiente de negócios dos clientes estratégicos, utilizando esse conhecimento para antecipar riscos e oportunidades.
  • Contribuir com insights qualificados para o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas, ajustes de posicionamento e evolução de estratégias comerciais, a partir da escuta ativa e do relacionamento próximo com as contas.
  • Reportar com consistência e precisão os KPIs de carteira para as lideranças, apresentando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas fundamentadas.
  • Atuar como mentor e referência para profissionais de contas em estágios anteriores de carreira, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento do time e a evolução das práticas de gestão de contas da organização.


COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS:

  • Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de gestão de carteira, com capacidade para estruturar pipelines de expansão, acompanhar health scores e gerar relatórios executivos com precisão analítica.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados de conta — consumo, receita, engajamento, risco — para transformar informações em estratégias de ação e narrativas de valor junto ao cliente.
  • Proficiência na construção de planos de conta (account plans) estruturados, incluindo mapeamento de stakeholders, análise de whitespace e definição de iniciativas prioritárias de expansão.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos de alto nível — QBRs, EBRs, propostas de valor e business cases — com rigor metodológico e clareza de comunicação.
  • Experiência com frameworks de gestão de contas estratégicas (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC, Miller Heiman ou equivalentes) aplicados ao contexto de expansão e retenção.
  • Fluência em ferramentas de comunicação, videoconferência e colaboração remota para condução eficaz de interações com clientes distribuídos geograficamente.


PERFIL E REQUISITOS:

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de contas estratégicas, Customer Success sênior ou vendas consultivas B2B com carteira de clientes de alto valor.
  • Histórico comprovado de expansão de receita em carteiras complexas, com métricas documentadas de NRR, up-sell e cross-sell.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade de interpretar dados de negócio, construir argumentos estratégicos e sustentar recomendações com evidências.
  • Habilidade de navegação em organizações complexas, com experiência em engajamento multi-stakeholder e influência sem autoridade formal.
  • Capacidade de liderança e mentoria para contribuir com o desenvolvimento de profissionais de contas em estágios mais iniciais de carreira.
  • Certificações em metodologias de gestão de contas, negociação estratégica ou vendas consultivas (diferencial).
  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA é considerado diferencial.
  • Trabalho 100% Presencial
  • Disponibilidade para Viajar uma vez por semana


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Visão de longo prazo e orientação estratégica — compreende que a gestão de contas é construída em horizontes de tempo, não em transações isoladas.
  • Inteligência relacional — lê dinâmicas interpessoais com acuidade, adapta o estilo de comunicação por interlocutor e constrói confiança com consistência.
  • Mentalidade de dono — assume responsabilidade integral pelos resultados da carteira, sem esperar que o ambiente externo dite o ritmo.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados — transita com naturalidade entre o relacionamento e a análise, usando ambos como instrumentos de criação de valor.
  • Proatividade estruturada — identifica oportunidades antes que se tornem óbvias e age com método, não por impulso.
  • Comunicação executiva — articula ideias complexas com clareza e precisão, tanto no nível operacional quanto no estratégico.
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional — mantém qualidade de presença e raciocínio em situações de pressão, renegociação e complexidade.


BENEFÍCIOS & EXPERIÊNCIA NA EMPRESA:

Aqui, você não encontra apenas um pacote de benefícios — encontra um ambiente pensado para alta performance, longevidade profissional e desenvolvimento real.

  • Cartão Flash flexível (alimentação / refeição / mobilidade)

Alta Performance & Saúde Integral

Acreditamos que performance sustentável exige corpo e mente alinhados. Programa Alta Performance e Vitalidade. Acesso a:

  • Treinamento físico com parceiros especializados (Elite Training)
  • Acompanhamento nutricional

  • Cantinho da Pausa & Bem-Estar — um espaço pensado para manter energia e foco ao longo do dia, com café premium, seleção de chás, frutas e snacks disponíveis durante todo o expediente


Desenvolvimento de Alto Nível

Investimos de forma intencional na formação de profissionais diferenciados — tecnicamente e intelectualmente:

  • Treinamento Em Busca da Verdade (EBV): Mais do que um treinamento, uma formação intelectual e humana. Acesso a uma sociedade de estudos clássicos voltada ao desenvolvimento de líderes com pensamento crítico, profundidade e visão de longo prazo.
  • Cursos de Aperfeiçoamento

  • Especializações técnicas
  • Desenvolvimento de soft skills (ex: oratória, comunicação, negociação)
  • Capacitações alinhadas às demandas da sua atuação


Cultura e Ambiente

  • Cultura orientada à alta performance com responsabilidade
  • Proximidade com tomada de decisão e impacto direto no negócio
  • Ambiente meritocrático, com espaço real para crescimento
  • Troca constante com profissionais de alto nível

title: Gerente de contas
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Mapeamento de mercado e identificação de clientes em potencial para os serviços oferecidos no portfólio da empresa;
  • Prospecção e visita de clientes potenciais, identificando novas oportunidades e buscando o crescimento da receita;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais dentro de cada cliente para captação de novos projetos apoiando sempre de forma consultiva para melhor integração da TI ao negócio;
  • Elaboração de propostas comerciais;
  • Negociação de taxas com clientes e profissionais para atingir o target necessário para fechamento do negócio de acordo com as metas estabelecidas;
  • Apoio aos clientes ativos nas rotinas necessárias para que os processos internos sejam atendidos;
  • Negociação de pagamento com clientes inadimplentes;
  • Interface das demandas comerciais com o sistema BullHorn (abertura de oportunidades e abastecimento de informações até o fechamento da oportunidade ou declínio);


O que você precisa ter

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Gestão de Negócios ou áreas afins;
  • Desejável Pós-graduação em Marketing ou área afins;
  • Conhecimento avançado em técnicas de vendas e negociação;
  • Conhecimento avançado nas ferramentas Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Excelente capacidade de planejamento, gerenciamento estratégico, foco em resultados, visão de longo prazo, senso de urgência, disciplina, relacionamento interpessoal e resiliência.


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

title: Operador de USV
description:
Sobre a TideWise

A TideWise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Operadores de USV para integrar nossa equipe de operações. Esta é uma posição que une a experiência marítima tradicional com a fronteira da robótica. Você será responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


1. Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo)

  • Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão.
  • Executar watchkeeping remoto, mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM.
  • Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões.


2. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução

  • Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação.
  • Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões.
  • Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção.
  • Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões.
  • Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações.


3. Manobras e Modos de Operação

  • Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP), decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação.


4. Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética

  • Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e \"quase acidentes\").
  • Operar sob procedimentos de contingência: quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos).


5. Registros e Evidências

  • Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes.
  • Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução).


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Aquaviário do 1º Grupo (Marítimo) – Seção de Convés: Oficial de Náutica (ON) ou CTR (Nível 5+).
  • Certificações: STCW válidos e compatíveis (II/3, II/5 e IV/2 - Rádio-Operador).
  • Experiência Prática: Navegação de embarcações de pequeno porte (menor que 20m e propulsão com dois eixos).
  • Navegação em regiões de alta densidade de tráfego não controlado (pesca e recreio).
  • Vivência em ambiente offshore/portuário e rotinas de convés.
  • Tecnologia: Experiência prévia com operações remotas (COR/ROC), VTS/VTMIS ou sistemas não tripulados (USV/ROV/UAV).
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência com mobilização, integração de sensores, testes e comissionamento básico.
  • Idiomas: Inglês instrumental (leitura de manuais, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica).


Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills)

  • Disciplina operacional e rigor com normas/procedimentos.
  • Consciência situacional sob carga cognitiva e tomada de decisão sob pressão.
  • Comunicação clara, padronizada e fraseologia operacional (VHF).
  • Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar, ética e integridade.


Benefícios TideWise:

  • Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação e Mobilidade oferecidos no Cartão Caju Benefícios.
  • Adicional de 25% no Vale-Alimentação por filho com idade inferior a 21 anos.
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Dental Sulamérica sem coparticipação para colaboradores.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • WellHub.


Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo!

title: Analista de Riscos Corporativos Sênior
description:
Somos o maior ressegurador do Brasil. Com mais de 80 anos de experiência, atuamos nas principais linhas de negócios em resseguros e contamos com uma equipe altamente qualificada, pronta para inovar e oferecer os melhores produtos e serviços ao mercado.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.


Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.

WHAT DO WE EXPECT?


• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),

• Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),

• Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.

• Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,

• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,

• Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

• Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,

• Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

• Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

• Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,

• Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

Time Commitment - 5-6 hours per day


About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Assess outputs for:
  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)
  • Strong understanding of grammar, syntax, and semantics
  • Ability to adopt different voices and points of view
  • Creative thinking
  • Strong attentive to detail
  • Well-honed internet research skills
  • Ability to embrace diverse teams

title: Billing analyst
description:
About the Role We are hiring a Billing Analyst (Contracts & Invoicing) to support a high-volume, enterprise B2 B billing operation within the telecommunications industry. This role owns the contractual and invoicing control stages of the Order-to-Cash process, acting as a quality, compliance, and accuracy gate between approved Purchase Orders and customer invoices. The position requires strong ERP execution, billing governance, and cross-functional organization.
Key Responsibilities
Execute and control the Contracts & Invoicing stages of the Order-to-Cash process.
Validate sales orders and invoices against Purchase Orders (POs), contracts, pricing references, and billing structures.
Create, update, and validate Sales Orders in ERP systems.
Prepare and review invoice drafts, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and audit readiness.
Manage invoice issuance, correction, and cancellation workflows with full traceability.
Register invoices and supporting documentation in official repositories.
Submit or share invoices through customer portals and approved channels.
Coordinate with Sales, Contracts, Projects, PMO, Warehouse, and Finance to obtain required billing inputs.
Track invoice status, blockers, aging, and SLAs, ensuring disciplined follow-up. Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related fields. Experience in Billing, Invoicing, Contract Administration, or Revenue Operations.
Strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2 C) processes.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems (TOTVS Protheus highly desirable).
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (controls, reconciliations, reporting).
Working knowledge of indirect taxation and invoice compliance.
Professional proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, infrastructure, or technology services.
Exposure to enterprise or Tier-1 customers.
Familiarity with invoice submission portals, acceptance workflows, and billing SLAs.
Experience operating in high-volume, month-end driven environments. Our compensation package:
- Contract as Brazilian Labor Laws (CLT).
- Profit Sharing.
- Transportation vouchers.

title: Emerging market trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Especialista em design de calçados
description:
Especialista em Design de Calçados Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ I.
A Missão da Posição O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2.
Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance.
Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.
II. Responsabilidades Principais Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.
III. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.
IV. Diferenciais Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Technical expert
description:
At Etex, our purpose is to inspire new ways of living.
We are an international leader in sustainable construction, driven by a passion for excellence, but it's our people that are our top priority.
We connect, collaborate, and champion the well-being of our employees, forming partnerships and pioneering change in our ever-evolving industry.
At Etex, we seek to make a meaningful impact on the lives of our customers and our communities.
Are you looking for a company where you can learn, grow and lead? Join us as an Technical Expert for Brazil, based in Río de Janeiro! The mission of the role is act as the key technical interface in large-scale industrial projects across South America, ensuring equipment specifications, installation, and performance meet Etex standards and international norms.
The role safeguards project delivery in terms of safety, timing, and budget, while supporting project managers and coordinating with suppliers, local teams, and stakeholders.
What you’ll do Develop technical specifications for equipment purchases and installations, aligned with Etex standards and customer requirements.
Review and align supplier proposals with international and group standards.
Monitor the full project lifecycle: engineering studies, manufacturing, acceptance tests, commissioning, start-up, and closure.
Supervise erection works on-site, ensuring safety and timely execution.
Provide recommendations to stakeholders to support decision-making.
Act as the interface between suppliers, local customers, operational teams, and project managers.
Support project managers with PMO methodology and reporting.
Manage budget responsibilities depending on project size.
Communicate effectively with multicultural teams and suppliers, maintaining leadership and authority.
What you’ll bring Engineering degree or confirmed technician background in mechanics or electricity/automation; knowledge of construction/civil works is a plus.
Minimum of 10 years’ experience in technical fields, with appetite for managing large technical projects.
Strong technical expertise in mechanics/electricity; proficiency in Auto CAD and MS Office.
PMP certification or equivalent is a plus.
Language skills: fluent English mandatory.
Strong communication skills and ability to challenge suppliers constructively.
Flexibility, resilience, and autonomy under remote management (Europe-based).
Ability to work collaboratively, avoiding silo mentality.
Why join us? We are named the world's #1 most trustworthy company in the construction sector by Newsweek and Statista in 2023! Our culture – we connect & care about those around us.
We nurture teamwork, communities, partnerships and new ways of working, placing the highest importance on the safety and working environment of our people.
Our ‘Road to Sustainability 2030’ is our plan to help build a better, sustainable future.
We work towards this vision by caring about our social and environmental impacts and developing innovative solutions We have a strong conviction that diversity of thinking helps us to deliver a strong and sustainable performance.
It is also essential for us that everyone feels part of the team.
In this spirit, we are committed to equal opportunities and zero tolerance towards discrimination Flexibility: For us, hybrid and flexible working is all about trust, and we want you to be able to do your best work (depending on the role).

title: Especialista de arquitetura e implantação | expansão
description:
Descrição da vaga No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, somos movidos por pessoas.
São elas que impulsionam ideias, constroem marcas e fazem a moda acontecer todos os dias.
Aqui, cada pessoa tem voz, espaço e responsabilidade na construção do que fazemos.
É assim, todos os dias, que nos tornamos o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.
Buscamos um perfil estratégico e multidisciplinar para atuar no coração da expansão do Grupo F&L.
Você será responsável por gerenciar a arquitetura e a implantação de lojas para diversas marcas do portfólio, garantindo que cada conceito criativo seja traduzido em espaços viáveis, rentáveis e escaláveis.
É uma posição de alta visibilidade, que exige trânsito entre o criativo e o financeiro, com foco em excelência operacional.
Responsabilidades e atribuições Desenvolvimento de Conceito Multimarca: Colaborar com os times criativos de cada marca (Reserva, Sprint, Oficina, etc.) para refinar conceitos arquitetônicos, garantindo que a execução seja fiel ao DNA de cada marca e economicamente viável.
Engenharia de Valor e Escalabilidade: Analisar criticamente os projetos para garantir que as soluções sejam escaláveis (rollout), definindo padrões técnicos que otimizem prazos e custos sem comprometer a estética.
Gestão de Implantação e Obras: Liderar o ciclo completo de obras e reformas de todo o portfólio do grupo, do planejamento inicial à entrega das chaves.
Interface Estratégica com Administradoras: Atuar como interlocutor técnico sênior junto aos grandes players de shopping ( Multiplan, Allos, Ancar, etc.
), negociando cadernos técnicos e prazos de aprovação.
Gestão de CAPEX e Parceiros: Equalizar orçamentos, realizar a precificação junto a parceiros estratégicos e garantir que cada inauguração respeite as metas financeiras do Grupo.
Homologação e Fiscalização: Selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores e empreiteiras, realizando visitas técnicas para garantir a qualidade de entrega e o cumprimento dos cronogramas.
Legalização: Coordenar os processos de obtenção de alvarás e licenças, garantindo a conformidade de todas as unidades do grupo.
Requisitos e qualificações Formação: Superior completo em Arquitetura e Urbanismo (preferencial) ou Engenharia Civil.
Experiência: Sólida bagagem em implantação de varejo, preferencialmente com experiência em gestão de múltiplas marcas simultâneas.
Bagagem de Mercado: Experiência em marcas que são referências em conceito e experiência de loja ou em grandes administradoras de shoppings é um diferencial importante.
Soft Skills Inegociáveis: * Comunicação e Articulação: Habilidade para escrever e falar com clareza, influenciando parceiros externos e reportando resultados para a liderança.
Autonomia e Proatividade: Perfil "dono do negócio", capaz de gerir múltiplos cronogramas e tomar decisões rápidas em cenários de obra.
Organização: Disciplina para gerenciar orçamentos e prazos de diferentes marcas ao mesmo tempo.
Ferramentas: Domínio de Auto Cad e Pacote Office (Excel avançado para controle de CAPEX).
Mobilidade: Residir no Rio de Janeiro e ter disponibilidade para viagens.
Informações adicionais NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS No Azzas 2154 Fashion & Lifestyle, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é parte essencial para construir o maior Grupo de Moda da América Latina.
Por isso, oferecemos um conjunto de benefícios pensado para apoiar o bem-estar, o desenvolvimento e o dia a dia de quem faz parte da nossa história.
Saúde e bem estar • Plano de saúde • Plano odontológico • Seguro de vida • Programas de bem-estar físico, como Wellhub ou Total Pass • Iniciativas de apoio à saúde mental Dia a dia e qualidade de vida • Benefícios flexíveis por meio de cartão Flash • Vale transporte • Day off de aniversário • Extensão de licença maternidade • Extensão de licença paternidade • Descontos nas marcas do grupo Desenvolvimento e crescimento • Programas de capacitação e desenvolvimento • Trilhas de aprendizagem corporativas • Iniciativas de reconhecimento e engajamento Reconhecimento • Participação nos resultados, conforme política vigente * Os benefícios podem variar de acordo com o cargo, a unidade e as políticas internas da companhia.

title: Institutional relations manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding.
Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership TM, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes.
We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office.
WHAT DO WE EXPECT?
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields; postgraduate degree or MBA will be considered a plus,
- Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure),
- Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME,
- Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners),
- Advanced English (spoken and written),
- Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments,
- Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities,
- Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally,
- Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics,
- High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices,
- Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions.
WHAT AWAITS YOU?
- Lead and execute KPS Brazil's institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives,
- Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders,
- Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,
- Proactively represent and defend the company's interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums,
- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),
- Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners,
- Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation,
- Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company's institutional positioning,
- Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning,
- Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making,
- Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS's institutional presence in Brazil,
- Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),
- Well-being and quality of life programs, including Total Pass,
- Professional and personal training and development opportunities,
- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,
- Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects.
In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Fx trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Strategic partnership & alliance
description:
About Rate Gain
Rate Gain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered Saa S solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. Rate Gain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today Rate Gain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.Exploring the role
Rate Gain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, Rate Gain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with Rate Gain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent Rate Gain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trendsEducation & Work Experience

High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership

title: Técnico em segurança
description:
KNOT is a Norwegian shipowner, the largest shuttle tanker operator in the world.
As we manage our own fleet, contracts and crew, we give a unique development opportunity for our seafarers and employees.
On top of that, we pride ourselves in being a company that values safety, innovation and growth for our employees.
Innovation, Credibility and Care are very important values for us.
This job opportunity is for a Safety Technician.
We are looking for professionals who are qualified, committed to joining our Brazil team, and who want to grow and collaborate with us and with our teams from around the world.
If you are hands-on, proactive and enjoy a challenge, join us! Job challenges: - Management of legal documents – PGR, PCMSO, ASO, LTCAT; - Monitor, and enforce KNOT’s HSEQ policies, procedures, and governing documentation; - Monitor company activities to ensure compliance with regulatory, client, and internal HSEQ requirements; - Ensure adherence to Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) and applicable local legal requirements, supporting their correct application in the workplace; - Manage the availability, distribution, and correct use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
- Take part in investigations and analyses of work-related accidents, incidents, and near misses; - Prepare technical reports, record findings, and communicate deviations, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
- Develop and support educational actions and safety campaigns related to occupational health and safety.
- Participate in HSEQ audits and inspections, both onshore and onboard vessels/facilities.
- Support internal and external inspections and follow up on action plans resulting from audits; - Participate in emergency response drills and simulations; - Support emergency response readiness and compliance with emergency procedures; Requirements: - Technical degree in Occupational Safety; - Previous experience as an Occupational Safety Technician, preferably in the maritime/naval industry; - Advanced English (frequent interaction with Norwegian colleagues and other cultures) – will be tested; - Experience in the implementation of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs); - Intermediate Excel skills; - Desirable: Bachelor’s degree; - Desirable: Experience with e Social system (Brazilian digital platform for labor, social security, and tax reporting).
Benefits we offer: - Food allowance; - Transportation allowance without discount; - Health and dental plan at no cost; - Life insurance; - Private pension; - Profit-Sharing; - Well Hub Membership.
If you meet the requirements and are interested in being part of a company that values its professionals, offers development opportunities and an excellent working environment, apply now.
All our job openings are also available to people with disabilities.

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho
description:
Atuar na prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, garantindo um ambiente seguro e em conformidade com as normas legais (NRs). Inspecionar locais de trabalho, orienta sobre o uso de EPIs/EPCs, realizar treinamentos, investigar acidentes e elaborar documentos técnicos.
Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades:
Prevenção e Inspeção: Realizar vistorias diárias para identificar riscos, inspecionar máquinas, equipamentos e garantir o uso correto de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPCs (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva).
Gestão de Riscos: Mapear riscos (físicos, químicos, biológicos, ergonômicos) e desenvolver planos de ação para mitigá-los.
Treinamentos e Cultura: Organizar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas de segurança, prevenção de incêndios e primeiros socorros, promovendo uma cultura de segurança.
Documentação e Conformidade: Elaborar relatórios, laudos técnicos, investiga acidentes de trabalho para evitar repetições e assegura que a empresa cumpra a legislação trabalhista.
Apoio a Emergências: Coordenar planos de evacuação e atua diretamente em situações de emergência. Formação Necessária:
É preciso ter curso técnico em Segurança do Trabalho, e experiência comprovada em carteira, desejável em Industria.

title: Power platform developer
description:
POSITION TITLE: Microsoft Power Platform Developer (individual contractor 6 – 12-month term with the possibility of extension, remote in Brazil)
JOB OVERVIEW:
Working with our IT team to develop Power Platform solutions and provide technical support for the Power Platform systems. We are seeking a skilled Microsoft Power Apps Developer to join our dynamic IT team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting business applications using Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate. This role requires a deep understanding of Power Platform, business process approval workflow, to create efficient and scalable solutions that meet our business needs.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Design, develop and maintain Power Platform Applications (specifically Dynamics) and related components (e.g., Power Apps, Power Automate).
• Experience writing and maintaining Power Platform flows for automation and system efficiency.
• Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.
• Integrate Power Platform with other Microsoft services including Power BI, and Share Point.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
• Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.
• Provide technical support and troubleshooting for Power Platform solutions.
• Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure effective utilization of developed applications.
• Working remotely cover 4 hours of US Pacific time zone (between 9:00am – 5:00pm PST).
JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Proven experience in developing applications using Microsoft Power Platform.
• Strong knowledge of Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and API.
• Experience with Microsoft Share Point, Microsoft Dynamics, and other Microsoft services.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Microsoft Power Platform certification is preferred.
WORK LOCATION:
Remote in Brazil

title: Brazil packaging salesperson, remote
description:

We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?
Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.
We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.
We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.
What you’ll do..
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion rates
This is not a passive customer success role.
It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.
You’ll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of results
What you’ll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis
